title: A gate added to an unclaimed item has a commit route, so the orchestrator's checkout stays clean for land
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: the orchestrator added and answered a blocking gate on the next item (ST-ihtjygip) before claiming it, and land of BG-5h2jpe3e stopped at step clean tree on that modified item file; it took a git stash to land. gate add (or land's clean-tree message) names the route for an item file changed before its claim: a backlog-planning commit of that file alone, or land names the item file and that route instead of a bare refusal.
